binding_findings.expected: Execution is denied when executable bytes are modified, missing, dirty, or differ from the stable executable inventory.
binding_findings.observed: tooling_identity derives the last commit and hashes only the inventory file; it does not verify current executable bytes, inventory membership, or working-tree cleanliness.

binding_findings.expected: Every GENERATE, REPLAY, and ACCEPT path performs mandatory preflight and output-root isolation before writes.
binding_findings.observed: CLI execution handlers validate authorization but call generation, replay, and acceptance directly without run_preflight or validate_output_roots.

binding_findings.expected: SUCCEEDED requires exact required artifacts and scientific metadata matching plan identity, seeds, partition, and schema with no extras.
binding_findings.observed: execute_generation accepts any nonempty artifact inventory and transitions to SUCCEEDED without semantic output validation.

binding_findings.expected: Replay rejects generation evidence whose plan, authorization, tooling, roots, run records, or seeds differ from the authorized replay input.
binding_findings.observed: execute_replay reads generation ledger records by run ID and artifact hash but does not validate the generation ledger identity against the replay plan.

binding_findings.expected: Acceptance verifies generation/replay plan, authorization, roots, seed sets, run records, and manifest consistency before passing.
binding_findings.observed: evaluate_acceptance checks selected contract, partition, operation, tooling, run IDs, artifacts, and replay flags but does not bind ledger plan hashes, authorization hashes, output roots, run-record hashes, or seeds.

binding_findings.expected: Preflight independently verifies frozen production evidence identities before scientific execution.
binding_findings.observed: run_preflight reloads the Stage A contract but never invokes frozen production evidence verification.

binding_findings.expected: Campaign and per-run locks provide validated stale-lock recovery and process-ID reuse handling.
binding_findings.observed: Only a campaign lock is acquired; lock_is_stale is not integrated into execution and there is no per-run lock or validated recovery operation.

binding_findings.expected: A fresh Windows core.autocrlf=true checkout preserves every inventory-bound executable byte length and SHA-256.
binding_findings.observed: The inventory binds LF Git blobs while execution and test Python paths have no -text/eol rule; all 19 inventory-bound Python files materialize as CRLF with different lengths and hashes in the independent Windows worktree.

binding_findings.expected: All proposal artifacts are regenerated byte-for-byte by a checked-in deterministic generator from explicit inputs.
binding_findings.observed: No proposal artifact generator exists; only committed outputs and self-tests are present, so independent byte-for-byte regeneration of all 12 proposal artifacts is unavailable.

final_verdict: NOT APPROVED FOR STAGE A DEVELOPMENT EXECUTION-AUTHORIZATION PREPARATION
observations: C:/absolute is accepted as the drive-relative Windows path C:absolute; it does not escape campaign_root but should be rejected explicitly for clearer fail-closed behavior.
